answer: SELECT CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' THEN pa.overall_rating ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' THEN pa.overall_rating ELSE 0 END)) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' THEN pa.overall_rating ELSE 0 END) FROM Player_Attributes AS pa INNER JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.date LIKE '2013-07-12%'
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN id = 6 THEN jumping ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN id = 23 THEN jumping ELSE 0 END) FROM Player_Attributes
SELECT id FROM Player_Attributes WHERE preferred_foot = 'right' ORDER BY potential ASC LIMIT 4
SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name FROM Player_Attributes AS pa INNER JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.attacking_work_rate = 'high'
SELECT pa.date FROM Player_Attributes AS pa INNER JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Kevin Constant' ORDER BY pa.crossing DESC, pa.date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk' THEN pa.overall_rating ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Paulin Puel' THEN pa.overall_rating ELSE 0 END)) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Paulin Puel' THEN pa.overall_rating ELSE 0 END) FROM Player_Attributes AS pa INNER JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
SELECT ta.buildUpPlayPassingClass FROM Team_Attributes AS ta INNER JOIN Team AS t ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE t.team_long_name = 'FC Lorient' AND ta.date LIKE '2010-02-22%'
SELECT DISTINCT t.team_short_name FROM Team_Attributes AS ta INNER JOIN Team AS t ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe'
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player)
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE SUBSTR(birthday, 1, 7) = '1970-10'
